27.text: The movable sleeping-room of the Reindeer Chukchee is not suitable to

28.text: melt ice in. For the night-time a kettleful of ice-cold water or of broth cooled

29.text: with pieces of hard snow is put inside for the benefit of the inmates. Its

30.text: place is on the skin in front of the lamp, where nobody is allowed to sleep.

31.text: Because of the general lack of room, the kettle is often upset by the foot of

32.text: one of the inmates, and the contents are spilled over the sleepers. This

33.text: arrangement presents another proof that the movable type of sleeping-room

34.text: is a comparatively recent variation from the stationary type, and is not

35.text: thoroughly adapted to the conditions it has to meet.
